findings.summary: The new HistoryRow open affordance navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId, but the diff adds no screen with that route; the only route changed is screen.logContact, which moved to /people/:id/events/new.
findings.evidence: effects: [Navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId to revise the event]  vs. only  route: /people/:id/events/new

findings.summary: Revising an existing event is a new capability, but the diff adds no operation, screen state, or journey step for editing an event; the only referenced event operation is operation.contact.log, which creates one.
findings.evidence: description: History has one row per event; each row opens the event for revision  /  operation: operation.contact.log
